title: Africa Shall Be Free Tri - Warrior King

lines.l: I'll be free, now listen to my plea
Put away the guns and let's give you the advice
Why hurt your sister, why take your brother's life
Have some tolerance, you should learn to socialize
For I'm a warrior of truth and right
Listen to my words, you can't even analyze
Words of wisdom will surely open up your eyes
Unity is stressed, why are we living so wide
The vision is weakness, so we need not fight
But we all are one, we all are one
I look towards the future with lots of confidence
Good over evil, no one of violence
Shall be free, now listen to my plea
Africa for Africans without the delay
Europe for the white say, that's where they must stay
Palestine for Jews, I say, okay
India for Indians, that's where they must pray
I speak only the truth, but that's what my father say
And even the prophets, Marcus Garvey
World readjustment, that's what I'm all about
Restoring the human family without a doubt
Put away the guns and this evil device
